name: April Dobson
occupation: State Representative; nonprofit professional; North Clackamas School Board member

bio.statement: The Oregon Legislature biography says Dobson represents Happy Valley, North Clackamas and Milwaukie and is serving her first term in the Oregon House.
bio.excerpt: This is my first term in the Oregon House of Representatives.

bio.statement: Ballotpedia quotes Dobson's Candidate Connection statement describing her as a mother of three and an elected member of the North Clackamas School Board.
bio.excerpt: A mom of three and elected member of the North Clackamas School Board.

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Dobson lists her occupation as state representative, with a background in nonprofit program management.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative and Mom Occupational Background: Non-profit Program Management

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: In a 2024 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Dobson pledged to defend the right to safe and legal abortion in Oregon.
positions.excerpt: defend the right to safe and legal abortion here in Oregon

positions.statement: Dobson says she is focused on reducing taxes for working families and stopping tolling in Clackamas County.
positions.excerpt: Reducing taxes for working families and stopping tolling in Clackamas County.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Dobson says she is focused on lowering energy bills by making data centers pay their fair share for power.
positions.excerpt: Lowering energy bills by making data centers pay their fair share for the power they use.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Dobson says she is focused on putting homeownership in reach of young families and stopping private equity from buying homes before Oregonians can make an offer.
positions.excerpt: Putting homeownership in reach of young families and stopping private equity from buying homes before Oregonians have a chance to make an offer.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Dobson says she is focused on protecting access to healthcare and defending fundamental rights.
positions.excerpt: Protecting access to healthcare and defending our fundamental rights.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Dobson says she is focused on cutting red tape for businesses and offering targeted relief for small businesses affected by tariffs.
positions.excerpt: Cutting red tape for Oregon businesses and offering targeted relief for small-businesses impacted by tariffs.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Dobson says she is focused on higher standards for public schools and more time in class.
positions.excerpt: Higher standards for public schools and more time in class so students can succeed.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 49
